newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Cagamas accepts 2.5-yr bonds at average 7.01 pct.
newsitem.headline: Cagamas accepts 2.5-yr bonds at average 7.01 pct.

text.p: Malaysia's national mortgage corporation, Cagamas Bhd announced on Wednesday it accepted bids at an average discount of 6.827 percent at its auction of 59-day notes for 435 million ringgit.
Cagamas also announced it accepted bids at an average yield of 7.01 percent at its auction of 2.5-year Tier-1 bonds for 250 million ringgit.
The bids accepted for the 59-day notes were in the high/low range of 6.888/6.720 percent, Cagamas said.
The bids accepted for the 2.5-year bonds were in the high/low range of 7.08/6.91 percent.
